author: vividvisionsoptometry
caption: When I showed my patient how prism glasses can help reduce driving anxiety… 👓🚗 With BVD, each eye may be seeing the world from a slightly different spatial position. It may not look like obvious double vision, but the two images may not overlay perfectly. Your brain then has to constantly work to pull those images together, especially while driving when everything around you is moving. Prism glasses help shift the images into better alignment, so the two eyes can line up the visual world more accurately. For the right patient, things may suddenly look clearer, crisper, more stable, and more naturally 3-D. That reduction in visual stress can make driving feel much more comfortable. 📍 Vivid Visions Optometry, Inc. #BVD #BinocularVisionDysfunction #PrismGlasses #DrivingAnxiety #DoubleVision
